description: ResumeFreePro is a free online resume builder that helps job seekers create professional, ATS-friendly resumes in minutes — and tailor them for specific job descriptions using AI. Most "free" resume builders are bait-and-switch — you spend 30 minutes building your resume, click download, and hit a $20/month paywall. The alternatives are either outdated Word templates with broken formatting, or LaTeX tools that require cod Key Features - **ATS-Optimized Templates** — Multiple professional layouts
